title: PermissionRuleSimulation
description: `POST /permission-rules/simulate`: what adding or removing rules would have changed in the caller's last invocations, against the trail's own record of what was actually decided (plan 15, B-16, D-15). Read only — nothing is stored, no event, no push. The mode is never in the trail, so every invocation is read under the canonical `ask`.

changes.description: Only the invocations whose verdict would change — the trail shows the rest unmoved.

answeringRule.description: The rule that would answer now — `null` when none would (the mode may still answer).

withoutFolder.description: Invocations with no folder on record — too old for `session_origins` (S-125).

assumedMode.description: The mode every invocation is read under, since the trail never kept the real one (D-15).
